per_question.question: Does NC Medicaid cover chiropractic services under Clinical Coverage Policy 5B?
per_question.agent_answer:
No. Clinical Coverage Policy 5B does **not** cover chiropractic services as such; Policy 5B governs **orthotics and prosthetics**, not chiropractic treatment. Its general coverage section is limited to beneficiaries eligible for **this service**, and the not-covered section denies services that do not meet the policy’s coverage criteria. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment).

- **Scope:** Section **2.1.1** states that an eligible beneficiary may receive coverage only if they are eligible for **this service** under Policy 5B, which is the **Orthotics & Prosthetics** policy. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)
- **Not covered:** Section **4.1** says a procedure, product, or service is not covered if the beneficiary does not meet the policy criteria in Sections 2.0 and 3.0. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

So if the question is whether **chiropractic services are covered under CCP 5B**, the answer is **no** because 5B is the wrong service category. I also checked for amendments, and the corpus identifies **Policy 5B, Orthotics & Prosthetics, as the current authoritative document**.
